name: open-claude-remote-clone
description: 局域网内通过手机/平板浏览器远程控制 PC 上的 Claude Code CLI

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ocr/shared build && pnpm --filter @ocr/frontend build && pnpm --filter @ocr/backend build && pnpm copy-frontend-dist
scripts.dev: pnpm copy-frontend-dist && concurrently --kill-others --handle-input -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @ocr/backend dev" "pnpm --filter @ocr/frontend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ocr/shared test && pnpm --filter @ocr/backend test && pnpm --filter @ocr/frontend test
